title: Owl on a jump rope totem
description: Simple resoursepack that changes totem of undying texture to "Owl on a jump rope" meme.
body:
EN: Resoursepack that changes totem on undying model to "Owl on jump rope" card, currently without custom sound for it.

RU: Ресурспак изменяющий тотем бессмертия на "Сову на скакалке", на текущий момент без кастомного звука.
